hero.title: Defined work, clearly scoped.
hero.intro: I am interested in research-adjacent work where my experimental materials background, scientific writing, literature experience and data skills can contribute to a concrete outcome.
hero.sideNote: The best fit is a focused question with a clear starting point and a useful result at the end.

services.title: Literature & scientific thinking
services.text: Focused literature searches, synthesis of a defined question, and helping turn a broad research idea into a clearer scientific direction.

services.title: Scientific writing & visualisation
services.text: Structuring technical material, improving scientific figures, and turning complex results into clear writing without flattening the science.

services.title: Analysis & presentation
services.text: Organising experimental data and building clear plots or visual stories using appropriate analysis tools.

closing.title: Let's see whether the question fits.
closing.text: Send a short note about the research problem, writing or analysis you have in mind.
